title: But what is the Riemann zeta function? Visualizing analytic continuation
summary: 3Blue1Brown visualizes the Riemann zeta function and the analytic continuation that extends it beyond where its series converges, building toward the Riemann hypothesis.
why: HN praises its visualizations, its handling of the -1/12 result, and its ending, and often prefers it to other explanations of the topic.
